content.json:
# Azure Local Day 2 Operations
A single operational workbook for continuous capacity, performance, balance and data-quality monitoring.

## Operational overview
Current cluster utilization based on the latest Azure Local SDDC management event.

content.query:
let NodeSnapshots = Event
| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-SDDC-Management/Operational" and EventID == 3000
| extend ClusterArmId = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.UserData.EventData["ArmId"])
| where ClusterArmId =~ "{Cluster}"
| extend Nodes = parse_json(RenderedDescription).m_servers
| mv-expand Nodes
| extend Node = tostring(Nodes.m_name),
         CpuPct = todouble(Nodes.m_totalProcessorsUsedPercentage),
         TotalMemoryBytes = todouble(Nodes.m_totalPhysicalMemoryInBytes),
         UsedMemoryBytes = todouble(Nodes.m_usedPhysicalMemoryInBytes),
         RunningVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsRunning),
         StoppedVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsStopped),
         FailedVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsFailed),
         LogicalProcessors = toint(Nodes.m_totalLogicalProcessors),
         NodeHealth = case(toint(Nodes.m_statusCategory) == 0, "Healthy", toint(Nodes.m_statusCategory) == 1, "Warning", toint(Nodes.m_statusCategory) == 2, "Unhealthy", "Other")
| extend MemoryPct = iff(TotalMemoryBytes > 0, 100.0 * UsedMemoryBytes / TotalMemoryBytes, real(null)),
         OtherVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsUnknown)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsPaused)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsSuspended)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsStarting)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsSnapshotting)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsSaving)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsStopping)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsPausing)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsResuming),
         TotalVMs = RunningVMs + StoppedVMs + FailedVMs + OtherVMs
| project TimeGenerated, Node, CpuPct, MemoryPct, TotalMemoryBytes, UsedMemoryBytes, RunningVMs, StoppedVMs, FailedVMs, OtherVMs, TotalVMs, LogicalProcessors, NodeHealth;
let Latest = NodeSnapshots | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Node;
let NodeCount = toscalar(Latest | summarize count());
let VmCount = toscalar(Latest | summarize sum(TotalVMs));
let AvgCpu = toscalar(Latest | summarize round(avg(CpuPct),1));
let AvgMemory = toscalar(Latest | summarize round(avg(MemoryPct),1));
print Nodes=NodeCount, VMs=VmCount, AvgCPUPercent=AvgCpu, AvgMemoryPercent=AvgMemory

content.json:
## CPU utilization trends
Use the trend and P95 views to identify sustained load and short-lived peaks.

content.query:
let ClusterNodes = materialize(
Event
| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-SDDC-Management/Operational" and EventID == 3000
| extend ClusterArmId = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.UserData.EventData["ArmId"])
| where ClusterArmId =~ "{Cluster}"
| extend Nodes = parse_json(RenderedDescription).m_servers
| mv-expand Nodes
| project NodeKey=tolower(tostring(split(tostring(Nodes.m_name), ".")[0]))
| distinct NodeKey
);
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ObjectName =~ "Processor" and CounterName =~ "% Processor Time" and InstanceName =~ "_Total"
| extend Node=tostring(split(Computer,".")[0]), NodeKey=tolower(tostring(split(Computer,".")[0]))
| join kind=inner (ClusterNodes) on NodeKey
| summarize CPUPercent=avg(CounterValue) by Node, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## Storage growth
Tracks used, free and total cluster volume capacity from Event ID 3002.

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-SDDC-Management/Operational" and EventID == 3002
| extend ClusterArmId=tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.UserData.EventData["ArmId"])
| where ClusterArmId =~ "{Cluster}"
| extend Hour=bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ClusterArmId, Hour
| extend Volumes=parse_json(RenderedDescription).VolumeList
| mv-expand Volumes
| extend Volume=tostring(Volumes.m_Label), TotalBytes=todouble(Volumes.m_Size), UsedBytes=todouble(Volumes.m_SizeUsed)
| summarize UsedTiB=sum(UsedBytes)/1024/1024/1024/1024, TotalTiB=sum(TotalBytes)/1024/1024/1024/1024 by TimeGenerated=Hour
| extend FreeTiB=TotalTiB-UsedTiB, UsedPercent=100.0*UsedTiB/TotalTiB
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Cluster storage growth
content.noDataMessage: No data returned. Verify Azure Local Insights and the required DCR counters are enabled.

content.json:
## Network throughput
Non-RDMA and RDMA counters are shown separately. Counter availability depends on the Insights DCR.

content.query:
let ClusterNodes = materialize(
Event
| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-SDDC-Management/Operational" and EventID == 3000
| extend ClusterArmId = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.UserData.EventData["ArmId"])
| where ClusterArmId =~ "{Cluster}"
| extend Nodes = parse_json(RenderedDescription).m_servers
| mv-expand Nodes
| project NodeKey=tolower(tostring(split(tostring(Nodes.m_name), ".")[0]))
| distinct NodeKey
);
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ObjectName in~ ("Network Interface","Network Adapter")
| where CounterName in~ ("Bytes Total/sec","Bytes Received/sec","Bytes Sent/sec")
| extend Node=tostring(split(Computer,".")[0]), NodeKey=tolower(tostring(split(Computer,".")[0]))
| join kind=inner (ClusterNodes) on NodeKey
| summarize BytesPerSecond=sum(CounterValue) by Node, ObjectName, CounterName, bin(TimeGenerated,15m)
| extend ThroughputMbps=8.0*BytesPerSecond/1000000
| extend Series=strcat(ObjectName, " - ", CounterName)
| project TimeGenerated, Node, Series, ThroughputMbps
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## Host utilization balance
Deviation is calculated against the current cluster average. Thresholds are operational signals, not Microsoft support limits.

content.query:

| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-SDDC-Management/Operational" and EventID == 3000
| extend ClusterArmId = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.UserData.EventData["ArmId"])
| where ClusterArmId =~ "{Cluster}"
| extend Nodes = parse_json(RenderedDescription).m_servers
| mv-expand Nodes
| extend Node = tostring(Nodes.m_name),
         CpuPct = todouble(Nodes.m_totalProcessorsUsedPercentage),
         TotalMemoryBytes = todouble(Nodes.m_totalPhysicalMemoryInBytes),
         UsedMemoryBytes = todouble(Nodes.m_usedPhysicalMemoryInBytes),
         RunningVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsRunning),
         StoppedVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsStopped),
         FailedVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsFailed),
         LogicalProcessors = toint(Nodes.m_totalLogicalProcessors),
         NodeHealth = case(toint(Nodes.m_statusCategory) == 0, "Healthy", toint(Nodes.m_statusCategory) == 1, "Warning", toint(Nodes.m_statusCategory) == 2, "Unhealthy", "Other")
| extend MemoryPct = iff(TotalMemoryBytes > 0, 100.0 * UsedMemoryBytes / TotalMemoryBytes, real(null)),
         OtherVMs = toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsUnknown)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsPaused)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsSuspended)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsStarting)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsSnapshotting)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsSaving)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsStopping)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsPausing)
         + toint(Nodes.m_vm.m_totalVmsResuming),
         TotalVMs = RunningVMs + StoppedVMs + FailedVMs + OtherVMs
| project TimeGenerated, Node, CpuPct, MemoryPct, TotalMemoryBytes, UsedMemoryBytes, RunningVMs, StoppedVMs, FailedVMs, OtherVMs, TotalVMs, LogicalProcessors, NodeHealth;
let Latest=NodeSnapshots | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Node;
Latest
| summarize CPUStdDev=round(stdev(CpuPct),1), MemoryStdDev=round(stdev(MemoryPct),1), VMStdDev=round(stdev(todouble(TotalVMs)),1)
| extend BalanceScore=round(100.0-min_of(100.0,CPUStdDev+MemoryStdDev+5.0*VMStdDev),0)
| project BalanceScore, CPUStdDev, MemoryStdDev, VMStdDev

content.json:
## VM density
Shows total and running VMs per host and per logical processor. Validate density against workload criticality, reserve capacity and failure-domain requirements.

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-SDDC-Management/Operational" and EventID == 3003
| extend ClusterArmId=tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.UserData.EventData["ArmId"])
| where ClusterArmId =~ "{Cluster}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ClusterArmId
| extend D=parse_json(RenderedDescription)
| project Running=toint(D.m_totalVmsRunning), Stopped=toint(D.m_totalVmsStopped), Failed=toint(D.m_totalVmsFailed), Other=toint(D.m_totalVmsUnknown)+toint(D.m_totalVmsPaused)+toint(D.m_totalVmsSuspended)+toint(D.m_totalVmsStarting)+toint(D.m_totalVmsSnapshotting)+toint(D.m_totalVmsSaving)+toint(D.m_totalVmsStopping)+toint(D.m_totalVmsPausing)+toint(D.m_totalVmsResuming)
| evaluate narrow()
| project State=Column, VMCount=tolong(Value)

| project TimeGenerated, Node, CpuPct, MemoryPct, TotalMemoryBytes, UsedMemoryBytes, RunningVMs, StoppedVMs, FailedVMs, OtherVMs, TotalVMs, LogicalProcessors, NodeHealth;
NodeSnapshots
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Node
| extend VMsPerLogicalProcessor=round(todouble(TotalVMs)/LogicalProcessors,2), RunningVMsPerLogicalProcessor=round(todouble(RunningVMs)/LogicalProcessors,2)
| project Node, NodeHealth, TotalVMs, RunningVMs, StoppedVMs, FailedVMs, OtherVMs, LogicalProcessors, VMsPerLogicalProcessor, RunningVMsPerLogicalProcessor
| order by TotalVMs desc
